title: Our $5000 Crypto Trading Tournament
author: Fynca
selftext:
Would anyone here join a $5,000 crypto trading tournament?

We’ve run two stock trading tournaments on Fynca so far, with $1,000 and $2,500 prize pools. A bunch of people from Reddit joined, and several took home prizes. Thanks to everyone who gave it a shot :)

https://preview.redd.it/13awvdoptwph1.png?width=2559&format=png&auto=webp&s=a8ec2b7cc4c0fb80af4d38c9145ac854005171df

We’re thinking about doing crypto next, with a $5,000 prize pool, but wanted to see if there’s enough interest here first.

Same setup: free entry, simulated trading, real cash prizes. No deposits or real money at risk.

Would you be up for it? Let us know in the comments so we can get a sense of the numbers.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
you'll get entries, but know what you're buying. a top heavy prize on simulated money pays people to run the wildest book they can, because finishing 30th and finishing 300th are the same outcome. the leaderboard ends up sorting on luck.

if you want it to mean something, rank on the worst loss each account took alongside where they finished, or run it long enough that blowing up actually costs someone. crypto makes that worse than the stock rounds did.
